banks.notes: The official March 2018 information sheet documents the bank-reference change effective 1 August 2018 and shows old/new CODA record 2.1 snippets alongside CAMT053/054 AcctSvcrRef snippets. This is historical mapping evidence for the Belgian bank, distinct from the BNP Paribas group entry. It is not a complete CODA file, does not establish current message versions, and was excluded from original-file counts. No complete public bank-published CODA original was verified.
